mechanism.summary: Cause-and-effect matrix gaps: individual tests pass, integrated interfaced response fails.

mitigation: Early C&E / FLS review from concept through shop drawings.
cascade: Last approval on the licensing path hits the opening date directly.

pacing.rule: Among licensing-path milestones that gate opening, the node with the greatest earliest_finish is the master pacer. Fire/CD typically computes as that node because it sits downstream of commissioning and holds occupancy.
